From cdc7daa9e3e102fc650321c8c0d2d8cf0ced3910 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?=D0=BD=D0=B0=D0=B1?= <nabijaczleweli@nabijaczleweli.xyz>
Date: Mon, 26 Sep 2022 17:15:54 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] a.out: restore CMAGIC
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Part of UAPI and the on-disk format:
this means that it's not a magic number per magic-number.rst,
and it's best to leave it untouched to avoid breaking userspace
and suffer the same fate as a.out in general

Fixes: 53c2bd679017 ("a.out: remove define-only CMAGIC, previously magic number")
Signed-off-by: Ahelenia Ziemiańska <nabijaczleweli@nabijaczleweli.xyz>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220926151554.7gxd6unp5727vw3c@tarta.nabijaczleweli.xyz
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/include/uapi/linux/a.out.h b/include/uapi/linux/a.out.h
index bb15da96df2a..5fafde3798e5 100644
--- a/include/uapi/linux/a.out.h
+++ b/include/uapi/linux/a.out.h
@@ -70,6 +70,9 @@ enum machine_type {
    The first page is unmapped to help trap NULL pointer references */
 #define QMAGIC 0314
 
+/* Code indicating core file.  */
+#define CMAGIC 0421
+
 #if !defined (N_BADMAG)
 #define N_BADMAG(x)	  (N_MAGIC(x) != OMAGIC		\
 			&& N_MAGIC(x) != NMAGIC		\
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `include/uapi/linux/a.out.h`**
   - A new definition for `CMAGIC` has been added with the value `0421`, which indicates a core file.
   - This modification restores the `CMAGIC` definition that was previously removed in a prior commit.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The addition of the `CMAGIC` definition is a corrective action to restore functionality that was lost when it was removed in commit `53c2bd679017`. The patch emphasizes the importance of maintaining this definition as part of the User API (UAPI) and the on-disk format to prevent breaking userspace applications that rely on it.

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the removal of the `CMAGIC` definition, which is essential for indicating core files in the a.out format. This removal could lead to compatibility issues with userspace applications that expect this magic number to be present, potentially breaking their functionality.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
// Removed definition of CMAGIC
// #define CMAGIC 0421
```
Reason:
The removal of the `CMAGIC` definition, which is crucial for identifying core files in the a.out format, creates compatibility issues with userspace applications that rely on this magic number for proper functionality.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
#define CMAGIC 0421
```
Reason:
Reintroducing the `CMAGIC` definition restores the necessary magic number for core files in the a.out format, ensuring that userspace applications can correctly identify and handle these files, thus maintaining compatibility and functionality.
